signal: HSI launched its Sky AI assistant in Jan 2026, partnered with Enhesa, and acquired HandsHQ and Skillko to expand EHS and European presence

email.body1:
Tom, saw HSI launched the Sky AI assistant, partnered with Enhesa, and folded in HandsHQ and Skillko to grow EHS and your European footprint.

That much expansion usually means more accounts in play than the team can cover before reps learn the new products and regions, and that is where deals stall. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for HSI off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress ~4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Tom, quick follow-up for HSI.

With new modules and regions in play, the addressable target usually grows faster than the team can cover. Most teams cannot say exactly how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late in the quarter.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings HSI needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Tom, last bit of proof for HSI.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how HSI's reply rate likely compares to other EHS software teams. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?
email.body4:
Tom, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount is not a priority while you integrate HandsHQ and Skillko, no problem at all. Multi-region expansion is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to an EHS motion? I will tailor it to HSI either way.
